==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Debiao:''' The battle in Norfall Barrens was so intense...
:'''Debiao:''' I also want to fight on the front lines!
:'''Debiao:''' Why am I stuck behind with these logistic duties...
:'''Lingfeng:''' The jobs done behind the city walls are also important. Just imagine if troubles stir up in the city...
:'''Lingfeng:''' Come on. Let's train more while we can. We need to be on duty afterward.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Lingfeng:''' The work is not easy recently... Hello, what can I do for you?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
:;(Set 1)
::'''Lingfeng:''' I need to work my muscles more. I haven't stretched for a few days and I feel dead on my feet.
::'''Lingfeng:''' When you have time, train more, or find someone to spar with.
::'''Lingfeng:''' Those guys over there do it. But they haven't beaten me yet. So take your time.
:;(Set 2)
::'''Lingfeng:''' When General [[Jiyan]] was a medic, he never neglected his training.
::'''Lingfeng:''' Although he was a medic at the time, he followed the military routines as did the soldiers.
::'''Lingfeng:''' So, this journey of a thousand miles, it all starts with this bit by bit training.
:{{DIcon}} About [[Shiyu]]
:;(Set 1)
::'''Lingfeng:''' Shiyu... Well, she's a nice girl. Hard-working. But you can tell she's keeping a lot to herself.
::'''Lingfeng:''' She's trying to look out for everyone, but it's not that easy. 
::'''Lingfeng:''' You say she's into liondances now? Haha, it's good to have a new interest.
::'''Lingfeng:''' Next time when the Liondance Troupe has a performance, I'll give her a day off to watch it.
:;(Set 2)
::'''Lingfeng:''' Last time, I gave her a day off to watch the performance of the Liondance Troupe.
::'''Lingfeng:''' She said she didn't want to, but when she came back, I found that she was genuinely happy.
::'''Lingfeng:''' She's going on and on about the spectacular performance of [[Lingyang]].
::'''Lingfeng:''' If the Liondance Troupe performs again, I want to go and watch.
:{{DIcon}} About [[Debiao]]
:;(Set 1)
::'''Lingfeng:''' When Debiao was young, he loved to spar with people. Then I don't know what had happened, he looked so depressed when I found him after I had returned from the army.
::'''Lingfeng:''' But now he's more active, and he trains hard every day. He'll be able to beat me sooner or later.
:;(Set 2)
::'''Lingfeng:''' This kid, Debiao, he's lost forty times, but he still wants to fight me!
::'''Lingfeng:''' That's the spirit—refusing to give in. He just needs more training.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Nothing at the moment.
::'''Lingfeng:''' It's good that there's nothing wrong, but it's not good to make a fuss here, just be careful.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
